_comment: Elasticsearch 9.5, self-managed, basic licence. Search p99 on the logs cluster went from 300ms to 3.8s over two weeks. The platform team has a change request open to double the node count and to raise number_of_shards from 5 to 40 on the daily indices.

cluster.index_pattern: logs-app-YYYY.MM.DD, created by hand every night by a cron job

what_we_know: The UI lets an operator page through results; support has hit 'Result window is too large' when going past page 500.
Nobody has run the query with "profile": true.
The cron job that creates tomorrow's index sometimes fails, and then writes land in yesterday's index.
Disk on each node is at 71%.
